scope: Corollary 2.10 (Source derivative bounds) of the manuscript “The low-temperature Sherrington–Kirkpatrick fluctuation scale” (preprints/The-low-temperature-Sherrington-Kirkpatrick-fluctuation-scale-September-24-2026/The-low-temperature-Sherrington-Kirkpatrick-fluctuation-scale-September-24-2026.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 217 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 e0e2e5e34169e701), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 13. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For fixed n, every derivative order of a continuation in bounded feature directions has a bound independent of the mass partition, uniform over the external source and the admissible bounded covariance clocks. The bound depends only on the order and the suprema of the feature directions.
